title: Disruption of TcGNBP3 via RNA interference compromises antibacterial immunity in Tribolium castaneum.
authors: Bi, Jingxiu; Li, Qing; Liu, Pingxiang; Li, Jingjing; Gao, Rui; Zhao, Tong; Yuan, Xuexia; Hao, Haining; Wang, Yutao; Li, Bin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究赤拟谷盗GNBP3的免疫功能，虽涉及分子对接但对象为蛋白-糖类识别，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Gram-negative bacteria binding proteins (GNBPs) serve as essential pattern recognition receptors in insect innate immunity, detecting pathogen-associated molecular patterns to activate downstream immune responses. This molecular recognition mechanism presents a promising target for pest control strategies. However, the immunological functions of GNBP family members in Tribolium castaneum remain poorly characterized, particularly for those with typical structural features. In this study, we identified and characterized a novel GNBP3 (designated TcGNBP3) from the T. castaneum cDNA library. Structural analysis revealed that TcGNBP3 exhibits the typical domain architecture characteristic of the GNBP family, comprising an N-terminal carbohydrate-binding module 39 (CBM39) domain and a C-terminal glycoside hydrolase family 16 (GH16) domain. Spatiotemporal expression profiling demonstrated peak TcGNBP3 transcript accumulation during the early pupal and late adult developmental stages, with predominant localization in immune-related tissues including the fat body and hemolymph. Bacterial challenges (Escherichia coli or Staphylococcus aureus) induced significant upregulation of TcGNBP3 expression from 6 to 72 h. Molecular docking and ELISA analyses demonstrated TcGNBP3's binding affinity for lipopolysaccharide, peptidoglycan, and beta-1,3-glucan, while functional assays confirmed its ability to bind and agglutinate five tested bacterial strains. RNAi-mediated silencing of TcGNBP3 severely compromised the beetles' immune response, suppressing immune-related genes (including transcription factors and antimicrobial peptides), disrupting prophenoloxidase cascade activation, and significantly reducing survival rates upon bacterial infection. These results identify TcGNBP3 as a key immune regulator in T. castaneum, supporting its development as an RNAi-based pest control target.
abstract_zh: 革兰氏阴性菌结合蛋白（GNBPs）作为昆虫先天免疫中的关键模式识别受体，通过检测病原体相关分子模式激活下游免疫反应。这一分子识别机制为害虫防治策略提供了有前景的靶点。然而，赤拟谷盗（Tribolium castaneum）中GNBP家族成员的免疫功能仍缺乏充分表征，尤其是那些具有典型结构特征的成员。在本研究中，我们从赤拟谷盗cDNA文库中鉴定并表征了一个新型GNBP3（命名为TcGNBP3）。结构分析显示，TcGNBP3具有GNBP家族典型的域架构，包含N端碳水化合物结合模块39（CBM39）域和C端糖苷水解酶家族16（GH16）域。时空表达谱分析表明，TcGNBP3转录本在蛹早期和成虫晚期积累达到峰值，并主要定位于免疫相关组织，包括脂肪体和血淋巴。细菌挑战（大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）或金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus））从6至72小时诱导TcGNBP3表达显著上调。分子对接和ELISA分析证明TcGNBP3对脂多糖、肽聚糖和β-1,3-葡聚糖具有结合亲和力，而功能实验确认其能够结合并凝集五种测试的细菌菌株。RNAi介导的TcGNBP3沉默严重损害了甲虫的免疫反应，抑制免疫相关基因（包括转录因子和抗菌肽）的表达，破坏酚氧化酶原级联激活，并在细菌感染时显著降低存活率。这些结果将TcGNBP3鉴定为赤拟谷盗中的关键免疫调节因子，支持其作为基于RNAi的害虫防治靶点的开发。
